items.title: Citi sees Permian Basin entering multi-year natural gas growth cycle
items.summary: The Permian Basin is moving into a multi-year expansion phase for natural gas infrastructure that could ease the takeaway constraints that have long affected the region, according to Citi analysts. The bank said the latest investment cycle differs from previous periods because infrastructure development is being supported by more durable sources of demand.
